text:
marie: quick note: the /v1/uploads page still shows a JSON body example for file uploads. runtime expects multipart/form-data for binary files. opened PR to replace the main curl example and add a FormData snippet. PR: #3348

tara: saw that — when I ran the example I got 415. good catch.

lint-bot: PR #3348 by marie: docs(upload): switch main example to multipart; add TS fetch with FormData; add migration note. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3348 :memo:

owen: two quick asks: 1) update OpenAPI requestBody to include multipart/form-data with `file` as type: string, format: binary and `purpose` string; 2) the response example in the current docs still uses `file_id`. runtime now returns `upload_id` + `filename`. we should update the response schema.

marie: plan: replace curl with `-F "file=@./sample.bin" -F "purpose=vector_index"`, add browser TS snippet with FormData and note about not setting Content-Type, and add a tiny migration blurb at top: "2026-03-24: uploads response field `file_id` renamed to `upload_id`."

tara: I'll add the tiny acceptance check to docs/tests: run the curl sample against local dev and assert 2xx and `upload_id` present.

owen: I'll patch the OpenAPI and run `openapi-cli validate`. ping me once markdown is up.

marie: pushed the markdown; PR updated.

owen: validated OpenAPI, fixed a small example indentation, tests passing. merging now.

tara: merged and closed. thanks all.

marie: will open a short SDK migration note after this.
